successConditions: The persistence and authentication failures have executable root causes
evidence: EnvSecretStore writes UI-entered SMTP secrets to an API-process-only Map while the worker resolves only process.env[secret_ref], so credentials disappear across processes and restarts
SmtpProviderAdapter.testConnection calls transport.verify() only; an unauthenticated connection can pass before the provider rejects MAIL FROM with 553 5.7.1 not logged in
Updating host, port or username does not reset a previously verified sender to pending, so stale verification can be reused
The edit UI intentionally leaves the password blank but exposes no durable-secret availability state, making safe non-hydration look like lost form data
